Original Royal Kitchen culinary illustrations

Five original editable vector compositions, drawn for this website from paths for cinnamon bark, star anise pods, marigolds, chilies, naan, cardamom and copper spice bowls. Warm yellow, orange, copper and beige palette. No stock artwork or reference-site illustrations used.
